offerings.name: Reader API (https://s.jina.ai)
offerings.pricing: API pricing is based on token usage. Prototype Development: $50 / 1 Billion tokens ($0.050 / 1M tokens); Production Deployment: $500 / 11 Billion tokens ($0.045 / 1M tokens).
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10M free tokens; non-commercial use only (CC-BY-NC).
offerings.output_type: Top five search results with their URLs and contents, each in clean, LLM-friendly text; JSON mode returns five structured entries.
offerings.note: 每次搜索固定消耗 token，起始为 10,000；免费/付费 Key 100 RPM，Premium Key 1,000 RPM。
